hero.title: The EU-native, ESCO-based, explainable Skills & Org Intelligence platform for the regulated mid-market
hero.subtitle: Govern skills, positions and organizational capability on a European public standard (ESCO) with auditable, AI-Act-ready recommendations.

esco.title: ESCO-native, open
esco.body: An EU public standard: no proprietary lock-in, cross-country benchmarking, interoperability.

explain.title: Explainable = AI-Act compliance
explain.body: Every recommendation (succession, flight-risk, gap) is deterministic and auditable before a regulator. No black-box.

position.title: Position-centric model
position.body: The position is a first-class entity: org-design and the structure↔process↔skill link that ERPs charge a fortune for.

icp.title: Who it's for
icp.body: European mid-market, 250–2000 employees, in structured and regulated sectors: banking, insurance, healthcare, utilities.

credibility.title: Built on standards, not promises
credibility.body: ESCO (European Commission) as the skills ontology, deterministic heuristics instead of opaque ML, a position-centric data model: every number traces back to its source.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Under Article 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), this notice explains how we process the data you provide through the forms on this site.
privacy.controller: Heuresys S.r.l. — for any request concerning your data, write to privacy@heuresys.com.
privacy.data: Through the contact form we collect: your name, company and e-mail address; optionally your role, your company's size and a free-text message. We also record which page the request came from (site, investors page or demo page), the date of your consent and the version of the notice you accepted.
privacy.required: Name, company and e-mail address are needed in order to reply to you: without them the request cannot be submitted. Role, company size and message are optional, and leaving them out has no consequence.
privacy.purpose: Your data is used solely to respond to your request and to contact you about Heuresys services. We do not use it for profiling, we do not subject it to automated decision-making, and we do not send unsolicited marketing.
privacy.legalBasis: The explicit consent you give by submitting the form (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). Consent is recorded with its date and the version of this notice, so you always know what you agreed to.
privacy.recipients: No one. Your data stays in our systems and is neither disclosed nor sold to third parties, except where required by law or by a judicial authority.
privacy.retention: No longer than 24 months from collection. Deletion does not depend on someone remembering: the window is registered in the retention system, which removes expired data. You may withdraw consent earlier, in which case the data is deleted on request.
privacy.location: Your data resides on Oracle Cloud infrastructure in the Milan region (Italy) — verified from the instance metadata: `eu-milan-1`. Processing therefore takes place entirely within the European Union, and no transfers to third countries are envisaged. Backups also remain in Italy.
privacy.rights: You may at any time request access to your data, its rectification or erasure, restriction of processing and portability; you may object to processing and withdraw consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal (Articles 15-22 GDPR). To exercise them, write to privacy@heuresys.com.
privacy.complaint: If you believe the processing of your data infringes the Regulation, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it) or with the supervisory authority of the country where you reside.
privacy.security: Access to the data is limited to authorised staff through authentication and named permissions; every administrative access is logged.

whistleblowing.title: Whistleblowing reporting channel
whistleblowing.legalNotice: This channel is reserved under Italian Legislative Decree 24/2023, handled solely by the designated custodian. No identifying data is stored, except for a contact you choose to leave voluntarily.

form.title: Submit a report
form.subtitle: The report is anonymous by default — leaving a contact is optional.
form.contactHint: You can stay fully anonymous by leaving this field empty. If you fill it in, the contact is visible only to the designated custodian.
form.successBody: Your report has been received by the designated custodian.
form.trackingCodeHint: Keep this code: it is the only way to follow the case.
form.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a few minutes and try again.

validation.subjectLength: The subject must be at least 3 characters long.
validation.bodyLength: The description must be at least 10 characters long.

status.title: Check your report status
status.subtitle: Enter the tracking code you received when you submitted the report.
